text:
Marc: quick pulse-check — I'm compiling a short review of recurring failures over the past 30 days. high-level clusters: cache thrash in inference pools, k8s preemption during scale-ups, and a tokenizer mismatch after recent model rollouts. want owners + ETAs for remediation. putting the initial heatmap here: https://redwood.internal/ops/heatmap/1852345678 :eyes:

Leah: numbers from the heatmap — cache-thrash: 18 incidents (30%), preemption: 11 (18%), tokenizer: 9 (15%). p95 latency bumps ~450ms during cache thrash events. I'll publish a short breakdown doc with representative traces in ~2h.

Sam: I can take cache-thrash ownership. short plan: (1) add KV length caps, (2) backoff on prefix cache writes, (3) surface prefix-cache metrics and alerts. target: WIP this week, PR by Fri. assigning to Sam.

Arjun: I'll own the k8s preemption cluster. suspect spot/eviction churn + pod disruption budgets not lining up with autoscaler. interim mitigation: prefer non-preemptible nodes for critical pools and tighten PDBs. I'll draft an autoscaler tweak + rollout plan. ETA: EOD Tue for proposal.

Emily: tokenizer regressions trace to model v2.3 rollout on 2026-02-02. I'll coordinate with model-ops to add a tokenization compatibility check to pre-serve validations and add a small regression test. I'll pick this up next sprint.

ops-bot: Incident heatmap updated: https://redwood.internal/ops/heatmap/1852345678 :robot_face:

Marc: action summary so we have clear ownership: Sam -> cache-thrash (PR Fri); Arjun -> preemption (proposal Tue); Emily -> tokenizer test (next sprint). Leah to maintain tracker and add acceptance criteria for each ticket. please add short TODO lines in the tracker and ping this thread when milestones hit.

Leah: tickets created: INF-4123 (cache caps + metrics), INF-4124 (autoscaler + PDBs), INF-4125 (tokenizer CI check). added short ACs and initial owners. I'll run weekly check-ins on Thursdays and update the tracker. :thumbsup:

Sam: quick design question — for cache caps do we prefer eviction-first or TTL-first for prefix entries? leaning TTL + LRU to avoid long-lived oversized prefixes. cc @Arjun for autoscaler interplay.

Arjun: TTL + LRU sounds reasonable. autoscaler changes are orthogonal; we'll canary autoscaler tweak on a dedicated pool to observe eviction rates before full rollout.

Emily: pinged model-ops and added a minimal CI snippet to validate tokenization mapping. snippet:

```
# tokenization compatibility check
python tests/token_check.py --model v2.3 --baseline v2.2 --seed 42
```

Marc: great. I'm recording this thread into the postmortem follow-ups doc and will schedule a 15m sync next Wed to confirm progress. calendar invite to follow. :calendar:

Leah: added calendar invite in #incidents for Wed 10:00am.

Sam: noted, will bring PR diff and perf numbers to the sync.

Marc: closing this pulse-check for now — reopen if blockers come up. :white_check_mark:
